entries.reason: Mool Mantar and Japji (Angs 1-8): no Mahalla is printed here, so the tag was empty; the composition is Guru Nanak Dev Ji's and its verses sign ਨਾਨਕ (e.g. Ang 8: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਕੇਤੀ ਛੁਟੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੧॥). Approved by the owner in the Lineage v2 plan, 2026-10-23.
entries.review: The closing salok (ਪਵਣੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਿਤਾ) also appears at Ang 146 under ਮਹਲਾ ੨ with variant readings; scholars attribute it variously. Kept with Japji; flagged.

entries.reason: Ramkali Sadu (Angs 923-924), heading ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਸਦੁ with no Mahalla; the verse is signed by its poet: ਕਹੈ ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੬॥੧॥ The tag had bled from Guru Amar Das Ji's Anand Sahib. Approved by the owner in the Lineage v2 plan, 2026-10-23.

Heading ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਰਦਾਨਾ ੧ ॥ (Ang 553, Bihagre ki Vaar). Many commentators read these saloks as Guru Nanak Dev Ji's, addressed to Bhai Mardana (the ੧ as Mahalla 1); others attribute them to Bhai Mardana. Unchanged pending scholarly review.

Ang 1253: the single line ਛਾਡਿ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਮੁਖਨ ਕੋ ਸੰਗੁ ॥ follows Bhagat Parmanand Ji's shabad and precedes ਸਾਰੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਸੂਰਦਾਸ ॥; it is traditionally Bhagat Surdas Ji's one line in the Granth. No heading or signature is printed with it here. The tag Bhagat Namdev Ji is a bleed: Namdev's last shabad closes at Ang 1253 (ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਐਸੀ ਤੈਸੋ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ॥੨॥੩॥) and Bhagat Parmanand Ji's shabad stands between it and this line. Proposed for G3 as Bhagat Surdas Ji, as ShabadOS 4.8.7 files it (shabad 5FC, writer Bhagat Surdas Ji). Author only: the line stays in composition 4846 with the shabad before it, as BaniDB/STTM groups it (shabad id 4531).

entries.reason: Ang 524: the heading ਸੁਧੁ ਰਾਗੁ ਗੂਜਰੀ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ opens Gujri's Bhagat Bani; the first composition under it is ਸ੍ਰੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕਾ ਚਉਪਦਾ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਦੂਜਾ ॥. Eleven of the other twelve such headings already carry the run's first Bhagat (13 in all; Ang 323's, line 14771, is the other exception); this one kept Guru Arjan Dev Ji's name because it starts with ਸੁਧੁ, the closing rubric of Gujri ki Vaar M5, which attribution.py never re-attributes. ShabadOS 4.8.7 sets ਸੁਧੁ at the end of the Vaar's last pauri and files the heading under Bhagat Kabir Ji (shabad 6AM).
entries.review: G3 A-11 asks what any Bhagat-run heading should carry (the run's first Bhagat, or no author); this entry follows the convention of those eleven until that ruling. The record mixes the Vaar's closing ਸੁਧੁ with the new heading; in the print ਸੁਧੁ ends the Vaar's last printed line and the heading is a separate centred line, so the join is the corpus's, not the print's (validation/attribution-g3-review/DECISIONS.md, A-11).
entries.hold: Applied in the held draft PR so the rebuild proves its exact effect; the PR merges only after the G3 scholar records the decision in `g3` (approve / change / reject).

entries.reason: Ang 323: ਸੁਧੁ ਕੀਚੇ ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਭਗਤਾਂ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ has the same shape as the Ang 524 heading (a Vaar's closing ਸੁਧੁ run into a Bhagat-run heading) and still carries Guru Arjan Dev Ji's name; the first composition under it is ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ ਚਉਪਦੇ ੧੪ ॥. Not in the G3 1.4.9 list; recorded so the scholar rules on both together. Changes nothing.

Raagmala (Angs 1429-1430) carries no Mahalla; its authorship is disputed (some attribute it to the poet Alam). The current tag is inherited from Mundavani. Proposed: leave unattributed and describe the dispute. Unchanged pending scholarly review.

Per-Bhatt splits in the Swaiyye (pipeline/bhatt_attribution.json) differ from an independent edition at Angs 1394 (Kalsahar/Jalap), 1396 (Sal/Bhikha), 1401-1402 (54 lines tagged 'The Bhatts'; Gayand) and 1409 (Mathura/Haribans). Scholars count 11 or 17 Bhatts. Unchanged pending scholarly review.

Inside ਸਲੋਕ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ, saloks 212-213 (Trilochan and Namdev in dialogue), 241 (ਕਹਿ ਨਾਮਾ) and 242 (ਸਤਿ ਭਾਖੈ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ) are signed by other Bhagats. Tagged with the collection (Bhagat Kabir Ji) as the independent edition does. Pending scholarly review.
Heading ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਕੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਰਲਾਇ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥ (Ang 326): written by Mahalla 5 alongside Kabir's verses. The printed heading governs; an independent edition credits Kabir.
Heading ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥ (Ang 1136) over ਵਰਤ ਨ ਰਹਉ ਨ ਮਹ ਰਮਦਾਨਾ. The printed heading governs; an independent edition credits Kabir.
Heading ਸਾਰੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਸੂਰਦਾਸ ॥ (Ang 1253): Guru Arjan Dev Ji's shabad that names Surdas. The printed heading governs; an independent edition credits Surdas.
